To conclude the proof, we must show that the distribution of relative heights is not modiﬁed by the operations of Figure 14 (Proposition 6.5), that the construction procedure is uniquely reversible (Proposition 6.6), that we generate all of our paths (Proposition 6.7), and that the algorithm aﬀects the generating function in the appropriate way (Proposition 6.8). □ Proposition 6.5.
